findings.text: The task ends with `just test-scheduled-checks`, but `AGENTS.md` ("Checks and their cadence") requires `just test-nix` and `just test-scheduled` at the end of a task. `just test-scheduled-checks` is a different recipe that skips the mutant suites. Fix: name `just test-scheduled`, or say that this task deliberately uses the narrower recipe and why.

The local-loop problem ("can therefore pass while a model change breaks these laws") is a possibility with no evidence: no failing check, measured cost or owner request. Fix: cite a case where `dev-build` passed and Nix failed, or an owner request for this change; otherwise reduce it to the one-line `justfile` change and drop the probe test of a temporary law failure.
